tools.name: bandpass_filter
tools.description: Zero-phase Butterworth band-pass filter; keeps content between `low_cutoff` and `high_cutoff` Hz.

tools.name: energy
tools.description: Short-time energy: integral of squared amplitude over each sliding window.

tools.name: fft
tools.description: One-sided amplitude spectrum via the FFT: how strongly each frequency component is present, scaled so a pure sinusoid of amplitude A shows a peak of height A.

tools.name: gaussian_filter1d
tools.description: Gaussian average: weighted moving average whose weights follow a Gaussian centred on each point, so nearby points count more than distant ones.

params.name: sigma
params.description: spread of the Gaussian weights; larger sigma = broader window and stronger smoothing

tools.name: highpass_filter
tools.description: Zero-phase Butterworth high-pass filter; attenuates content below `cutoff` Hz.

tools.name: kurtosis
tools.description: Sliding-window kurtosis (Fisher, excess): tailedness of the amplitude distribution; large values flag spiky, outlier-heavy segments.

tools.name: line_length
tools.description: Line length: sum of absolute sample-to-sample differences in each sliding window. Sensitive to both amplitude and frequency increases; a classic iEEG seizure-detection feature.

tools.name: lowpass_filter
tools.description: Zero-phase Butterworth low-pass filter; attenuates content above `cutoff` Hz.

tools.name: moving_average
tools.description: Moving average: each point becomes the mean of the `win_size` points around it.

params.name: win_size
params.description: number of data points used to compute the average

tools.name: moving_median
tools.description: Moving median: each point becomes the median of the `win_size` points around it; robust to outliers/spikes.

params.name: win_size
params.description: number of data points used to compute the median

tools.name: notch_filter
tools.description: Zero-phase IIR notch filter; removes a narrow band centered at `w0` Hz (default 60 Hz mains interference).

params.name: w0
params.description: center frequency to notch out (default 60, US mains)

tools.name: power
tools.description: Short-time power: mean squared amplitude over each sliding window.

tools.name: psd
tools.description: Power spectral density (Welch's method): how the signal's power distributes across frequency, separating sustained features from noise. Useful for characterising brain states, locating seizure-onset zones, and tracking high-frequency oscillations.

params.name: win_size
params.description: Welch segment length; longer segments give finer frequency resolution, shorter ones smoother estimates (default 1 s, capped at the signal length)

tools.name: rms
tools.description: Root-mean-square amplitude over each sliding window; an amplitude envelope in the signal's own unit.

tools.name: savgol_filter
tools.description: Savitzky-Golay filter: slides a symmetric `win_size` window along the series, fits a degree-`polyorder` polynomial in each window, and replaces the centre point with the polynomial's value.

params.name: polyorder
params.description: polynomial degree fitted in each window; higher degrees follow more complex local curves

tools.name: skewness
tools.description: Sliding-window skewness: asymmetry of the amplitude distribution around its mean (0 for symmetric signals).

tools.name: zcr
tools.description: Zero-crossing rate: sign changes per second within each sliding window; a cheap proxy for the dominant frequency of the trace.
